Abstract.AbstractText: Phytochemical investigation of the barks of Juglans mandshurica Maxim led to the isolation, purification, and identification of one new lignan named Juglansol A (1), along with nine known compounds (2-10). Their structures were determined by the results of UV, IR, CD, HRESIMS, 1D, and 2D NMR spectroscopic analysis. Compounds 1-10 were evaluated for their cytotoxicities against A549, HepG2, Hep3B, Bcap-37, and MCF-7 cell lines. The results showed that compound 2 possessed stronger cytotoxicities against the tested tumor cell lines compared with positive control 5-fluorouracil.
